title: X-pressing Intimacy: Mental Health Disclosure After Twitter Acquisition
abstract: arXiv:2610.30413v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Social media platforms provide spaces for individuals to disclose mental health experiences and seek support, yet how these disclosures evolve during major shifts in platform governance remains unclear. We examine mental health self-disclosure surrounding Elon Musk's October 2022 acquisition of Twitter, analyzing approximately 824K tweets across anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder (BD), borderline personality disorder (BPD), and suicidal ideation (SI) or related experiences, alongside 266K comparison tweets. Using Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count (LIWC) and an LLM-based intimacy classifier, we characterize changes in psycholinguistic expression and disclosure intimacy. Following the acquisition, we observe declines in affective and social language, alongside increases in first-person singular pronouns and future-focused expressions. translated_title: 「X」诉衷肠：Twitter收购后的心理健康披露
translated_abstract: 社交媒体平台为个人提供了披露心理健康经历并寻求支持的空间，但这些披露在平台治理发生重大变动时会如何演变仍不清楚。我们围绕埃隆·马斯克2022年10月收购Twitter这一事件，考察了心理健康自我披露情况，分析了涵盖焦虑、抑郁症、双相情感障碍（BD）、边缘型人格障碍（BPD）以及自杀意念（SI）或相关经历的约82.4万条推文，并同时分析了26.6万条对照推文。借助语言查询与字词计数工具（LIWC）以及基于大语言模型（LLM）的亲密度分类器，我们刻画了心理语言学表达与披露亲密度的变化。收购之后，我们观察到情感性和社会性语言有所减少，同时第一人称单数代词和面向未来的表达有所增加。亲密度模式因具体病症而异：焦虑、抑郁和BPD呈现出低亲密度……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文利用LIWC与基于大语言模型的亲密度分类器分析约82.4万条推文，揭示了马斯克收购Twitter后用户心理健康自我披露的变化：情感与社会性语言减少、第一人称单数及未来导向表达增加，且披露亲密度的变化模式因病症而异。
en_tdlr: Analyzing ~824K tweets with LIWC and an LLM-based intimacy classifier, this study reveals that after Musk's acquisition of Twitter, mental health disclosures showed declining affective and social language, rising first-person and future-focused expression, with intimacy shifts varying across conditions.
